metadata.title: Spiritual Entities of The Grand Bible
metadata.description: Categorized spiritual entities, divine beings, angelic hierarchies, fallen spirits, realms, and primordial creatures explicitly present across the primary texts, apocrypha, gnostic gospels, and interfaith scriptures included in The Grand Bible.

categories.description: Supreme ultimate realities, monotheistic titles, divine emanations, and major deities from biblical, ancient near eastern, and eastern traditions.

entities.name: Yahweh / YHWH
entities.description: The covenantal name of God in the Hebrew Bible.

entities.name: Elohim
entities.description: Plural title for the Divine/God in Genesis and Hebrew texts.

entities.name: Allah
entities.description: The One God in Islamic scriptures.

entities.name: Brahman
entities.description: The unmanifest, ultimate, unchanging reality in Upanishadic and Vedic texts.

entities.name: Brahma
entities.description: The creator god in Hindu cosmology.

entities.name: Vishnu
entities.description: The preserver deity who incarnates as avatars (Krishna, Rama).

entities.name: Shiva
entities.description: The deity of cosmic destruction, transformation, and asceticism.

entities.name: Krishna
entities.description: Eighth avatar of Vishnu, central speaker of the Bhagavad Gita.

entities.name: Rama
entities.description: Seventh avatar of Vishnu and central hero of the Ramayana.

entities.name: Ahura Mazda
entities.description: The supreme wise lord of Zoroastrian scriptures included in comparative sections.

entities.name: Sophia
entities.description: Personified Divine Wisdom in the Old Testament Apocrypha and Gnostic texts.

entities.name: Barbelo
entities.description: The first divine forethought/emanation of the Supreme Invisible Spirit in Gnostic texts.

entities.name: Saraswati
entities.description: Goddess of knowledge, wisdom, speech, and learning.

entities.name: Lakshmi
entities.description: Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and spiritual abundance.

entities.name: Ashtoreth / Astarte
entities.description: Ancient Near Eastern goddess of fertility, war, and love referenced in biblical texts.

entities.name: Baal
entities.description: Canaanite storm and fertility deity frequently referenced in the Hebrew Bible.

entities.name: Molech
entities.description: Canaanite deity associated with child sacrifice in biblical historical books.

entities.name: Dagon
entities.description: Philistine agricultural and fertility deity mentioned in 1 Samuel.

entities.name: Tiamat
entities.description: Primordial ocean goddess of chaos in Mesopotamian mythology.

categories.description: Celestial angelic orders, choirs, archangels, and specific divine messengers.

entities.name: Seraphim
entities.description: Six-winged burning ones that surround the throne of God.

entities.name: Cherubim
entities.description: Four-faced living beings guarding holy ground, Eden, and the Ark of the Covenant.

entities.name: Thrones (Ophanim / Wheels)
entities.description: Many-eyed living wheels associated with God's throne chariot.

entities.name: Dominions (Kyriotetes)
entities.description: Angelic rulers regulating the duties of lower angelic orders.

entities.name: Virtues (Dynameis)
entities.description: Angelic spirits associated with divine miracles and cosmic order.

entities.name: Powers (Exousiai)
entities.description: Warrior angels overseeing cosmic boundaries and combating demonic forces.

entities.name: Principalities (Archai)
entities.description: Angelic guardians over nations, territories, and human institutions.

entities.name: Archangels
entities.description: Chief angels carrying out crucial messages and cosmic tasks.

entities.name: Michael
entities.description: Archangel of protection, heavenly general, defender of the righteous.

entities.name: Gabriel (Jibril)
entities.description: Chief divine messenger delivering revelations to prophets.

entities.name: Raphael
entities.description: Archangel of healing, binding of demon Asmodeus, and human guidance.

entities.name: Uriel
entities.description: Archangel of wisdom, celestial light, and guardian of Tartarus.

entities.name: Metatron
entities.description: Transformed Enoch serving as supreme heavenly scribe and Chancellor of Heaven.

entities.name: Sandalphon
entities.description: Elijah's angelic counterpart who gathers human prayers into wreaths for God.

entities.name: Israfil
entities.description: The archangel who blows the trumpet signaling the Day of Resurrection.

entities.name: Azrael
entities.description: The archangel of death responsible for taking human souls at appointed times.

entities.name: Raziel
entities.description: Angel of divine secrets and keeper of the Sefer Raziel.

entities.name: Kiraman Katibin
entities.description: Pair of angels recording good and bad deeds of every person.

entities.name: Munkar and Nakir
entities.description: Angels who question souls in the grave regarding faith and deeds.

categories.description: Fallen Watchers, demonic lords, and adversarial spiritual entities across canonical and apocryphal sources.

entities.name: Satan / Ha-Satan
entities.description: The chief adversary, prosecutor, and opponent of God and mankind.

entities.name: Lucifer
entities.description: The fallen morning star associated with pride and fall from heaven.

entities.name: Iblis
entities.description: The primary adversary in Islam who refused to bow to Adam due to pride.

entities.name: Semyaza
entities.description: Chief leader of the 200 Watchers who descended upon Mount Hermon.

entities.name: Azazel
entities.description: Fallen angel who taught humans warfare and cosmetics, bound in the desert.

entities.name: Beelzebub
entities.description: High demonic authority known as the Lord of the Flies / Prince of Demons.

entities.name: Belial
entities.description: Leader of darkness and spirit of lawlessness in intertestamental writings.

entities.name: Asmodeus
entities.description: Demon of lust and destruction bound by Raphael in Tobit.

entities.name: Lilith
entities.description: Night demon associated with screech owls, desert wastes, and newborn harm.

entities.name: Abaddon / Apollyon
entities.description: King of the demonic locusts and ruler of the bottomless pit of destruction.

categories.description: Cosmological realms, spiritual planes, heavens, and underworlds present in the compilation.

entities.name: The Seven Heavens
entities.description: Ascending tiers of cosmic heavens (Vilon, Raki'a, Shehaqim, Zebul, Ma'on, Machon, Araboth).

entities.name: Pleroma
entities.description: The totality of divine power, light, and spiritual emanations.

entities.name: Garden of Eden / Jannah
entities.description: The original paradise created for mankind and the eternal abode of the righteous.

entities.name: Sheol
entities.description: The shadowy subterranean realm of departed human spirits.

entities.name: Tartarus
entities.description: The deepest subterranean prison where fallen Watchers are chained in darkness.

entities.name: Gehenna / Jahannam
entities.description: The valley/place of fire for final judgment and purification of evil souls.

entities.name: Svarga / Devaloka
entities.description: The celestial paradise of the gods (Devas) ruled by Indra.

entities.name: Naraka
entities.description: The underworld realm of retribution overseen by Yama.

categories.description: Elemental spirits, jinn, demonic races, and primordial cosmic beasts.

entities.name: Jinn
entities.description: Spiritual beings created from smokeless fire possessing free will.

entities.name: Ifrit
entities.description: A powerful class of Jinn known for strength, speed, and cunning.

entities.name: Marid
entities.description: Powerful aquatic Jinn associated with open waters and immense power.

entities.name: Asuras
entities.description: Powerful entities in constant cosmic opposition to the heavenly Devas.

entities.name: Yakshas
entities.description: Guardian spirits of forests, natural treasures, and wild earth.

entities.name: Rakshasas
entities.description: Fierce, shape-shifting demonic beings of wild lands and nighttime.

entities.name: Rephaim / Shades
entities.description: Spirits of ancient giants and ancestral shades inhabiting Sheol.

entities.name: Leviathan
entities.description: The great multi-headed sea serpent of chaotic waters.

entities.name: Behemoth
entities.description: The gigantic primordial land monster symbolizing unmatched physical strength.

entities.name: Ziz
entities.description: The colossal primordial bird whose wings block out the sun.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Offspring produced by the fallen Watchers and human daughters.

entities.name: The Seven-Headed Dragon
entities.description: The red dragon in the heavens representing cosmic Satanic power.
